title: Solitaire (Klondike): how to play
sections: Move all 52 cards to the four foundation spaces at the top right: one per suit, from Ace up to King.

On the piles, cards go downwards in alternating colours: a red 7 on a black 8, for example. You can move a whole run of face-up cards at once. A face-down card turns over when it is uncovered. Only a King (or a run starting with a King) may go into an empty pile.
Tap the deck at the top left to draw cards onto the waste pile beside it; the top waste card can be played. When the deck is empty, tap it again to turn the waste back over.
Drag a card (or run) to where you want it, or just tap it and it goes to the best place it fits. Undo takes back a move. When all cards are face up, Auto finish plays the rest for you.
Uncover face-down cards first, they hold the cards you need. Don't empty a pile unless you have a King ready to go there. Move Aces and Twos to the foundations straight away.
Easy and Normal draw one card at a time; Hard draws three. Fewer moves and less time score more.
